Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences (FoMHS)

Global health conference

The Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences is a conscious response to the growing concern of healthcare education and management across the world and the rapidly growing healthcare industry. The FoMHS works to create a health momentum towards the ultimate objective of creating a healthy world. The constituent institutes/departments under FoMHS include : Read more...

  SYMHEALTH 2026

On behalf of the Symbiosis International (Deemed University) SIU, a two days National Conference on Embracing Smart Healthcare: Predictive, Precision and Personalized Health Systems. A Pathway to Achieving SGDs for Healthier Future Generations is being hosted at Symbiosis International University, Lavale - Pune on April 17th & 18th, 2026.

This annual mega event with a legacy of 25 years attracts over 1400 delegates from all verticals of healthcare such as doctors, medico legal experts, insurance & IT professionals, NGOs, hospital administrators & clinical research professionals from all over India and abroad. Officials of institutional / corporate hospitals, government officials & representatives of the health care sector also mark their attendance for this event. The event boasts of stalwart speakers, contemporary topics and provides an opportunity for professional upgradation, paper presentation, master classes, liaison and networking.
